title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF Jordan revised work plans, rolled out the Field Monitoring Module, and conducted mid-year and annual reviews. These elements have led to improved quality and equity of programmes, with programme adjustments made as needed. Results-based management workshops were held with both internal and external staff resulting in greater understanding of participants on theory of change logic.
